reviews.comment: Professor Heim has easily been one of my favorite professors in the INFO department. Heim really respects his students and does not overload you with a lot of work. He teaches many aspects of the real business world including writing reports, giving presentations, and market research. Tests are easy if you listen and participate in discussions.

One of the top-notch SCMT classes you need to take. Professor Heim maintains a high level of professionalism and keeps the class engaged with interactive peer activities and presentations. His wealth of anecdotes adds depth to the learning experience, complementing a range of assignments, projects, presentations, exams, and even a game.

This class was really tough but most people ended up with As and Bs. Be prepared for lots of group work, reading assignments, case studies and exec summaries. There are only two exams that are fairly easy. The professor is really nice. If you put in the effort, you can easily make a B, however it will take hours of work.
Great Professor. Very willing to help his students and give feedback. Participation is a major part of your grade so make sure you attend class!
